design: Mean normalized MLP-context shift per family/template/layer fit on first four pairs only. Predict donor y as receiver y + mean shift; no renormalization. Compare exact context-only replacement, zero shift, and norm-matched shift from other family at same template index. Native attention/MLP normalization, both input/readout choices.
limitations: Retrospective item holdout after H640; no fitting to output derivatives, three probes all excluded from shift fitting. Donor input/readout are still accessed in those explicitly conditioned modes. Not an end-to-end donor prediction or low-rank operator proof.
